C_corpus_no_result_match.action: Accept as training-excluded. Investigate if pattern (e.g. all abandoned races, AW cards, Ireland-only cards).

E_x_tier_by_design.explanation: X-tier rows are in corpus but excluded from SR/frame calculations by audit design. They are included in the training slice for completeness but labelled.

F_missing_horse_id.explanation: Rows without horse_id — identity not resolved from any source.

G_insufficient_fields.explanation: Rows missing 3+ of 4 key signal fields (VP, MDS, improvement, place_prob).
